class OrderReactivateTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        self.o = Organizer.objects.create(name='Dummy', slug='dummy')
        with scope(organizer=self.o):
            self.event = Event.objects.create(organizer=self.o, name='Dummy', slug='dummy', date_from=now(),
                                              plugins='tests.testdummy')
            self.order = Order.objects.create(
                code='FOO', event=self.event, email='dummy@dummy.test',
                status=Order.STATUS_PENDING, locale='en',
                datetime=now(), expires=now() + timedelta(days=10),
                total=Decimal('46.00'),
                sales_channel=self.event.organizer.sales_channels.get(identifier="web"),
            )
            self.ticket = Item.objects.create(event=self.event, name='Early-bird ticket',
                                              default_price=Decimal('23.00'), admission=True)
            self.quota = self.event.quotas.create(name='Tickets', size=2)
            self.quota.items.add(self.ticket)
            self.op1 = OrderPosition.objects.create(
                order=self.order, item=self.ticket, variation=None,
                price=Decimal("23.00"), attendee_name_parts={'full_name': "Peter"}, positionid=1
            )
            self.op2 = OrderPosition.objects.create(
                order=self.order, item=self.ticket, variation=None,
                price=Decimal("23.00"), attendee_name_parts={'full_name': "Dieter"}, positionid=2
            )
            self.order.create_transactions()
            generate_invoice(self.order)
            djmail.outbox = []

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_reactivate_not_canceled(self):
        with pytest.raises(OrderError):
            reactivate_order(self.order)

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_reactivate_unpaid(self):
        cancel_order(self.order.pk)
        reactivate_order(self.order)
        self.order.refresh_from_db()
        assert self.order.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING
        assert self.order.cancellation_date is None
        assert self.order.expires > now()
        assert self.order.all_logentries().last().action_type == 'pretix.event.order.reactivated'
        assert self.order.transactions.count() == 2

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_reactivate_paid(self):
        self.order.payments.create(state=OrderPayment.PAYMENT_STATE_CONFIRMED, amount=Decimal('46.00'),
                                   provider='manual')
        cancel_order(self.order.pk)
        reactivate_order(self.order)
        self.order.refresh_from_db()
        assert self.order.status == Order.STATUS_PAID
        assert self.order.cancellation_date is None

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_reactivate_generates_invoice(self):
        cancel_order(self.order.pk)
        assert self.order.invoices.count() == 2
        reactivate_order(self.order)
        assert self.order.invoices.count() == 3

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_reactivate_restores_voucher(self):
        self.op1.voucher = self.event.vouchers.create(item=self.ticket, redeemed=1)
        self.op1.save()
        cancel_order(self.order.pk)
        self.op1.voucher.refresh_from_db()
        assert self.op1.voucher.redeemed == 0
        reactivate_order(self.order)
        self.op1.voucher.refresh_from_db()
        assert self.op1.voucher.redeemed == 1

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_reactivate_unavailable(self):
        cancel_order(self.order.pk)
        self.quota.size = 1
        self.quota.save()
        with pytest.raises(OrderError):
            reactivate_order(self.order)
        self.order.refresh_from_db()
        assert self.order.status == Order.STATUS_CANCELED

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_reactivate_unavailable_force(self):
        cancel_order(self.order.pk)
        self.quota.size = 1
        self.quota.save()
        reactivate_order(self.order, force=True)
        self.order.refresh_from_db()
        assert self.order.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING
EOF
